name: Bearded goby
description: Bearded goby (Sufflogobius bibarbatus) - a small bottom-hugging fish that in this 1956 web is a minor plankton grazer, but which after the sardine collapse multiplied into one of the most abundant fish stocks on Earth, able to feed in the shelf's oxygen-poor mud layers and even on jellyfish. Life-stage group of the source model's juvenile and adult goby stanzas, measured separately and pooled here because the two stanzas form one population.
